title: How to Prepare for Your Mobile Car Detailing Appointment in Duncan, BC
metaDescription: Learn how to prepare for mobile car detailing in Duncan, BC. Simple steps to get your vehicle ready so your Cowichan Valley detail goes faster and smoother.
keywords: how to prepare for mobile car detailing
excerpt: A few minutes of prep before we arrive means a faster appointment and better results. Here's exactly what to do before your mobile detail.

content.text: One of the best things about booking a mobile detail is that you don't have to go anywhere. We bring the water, power, and equipment right to your driveway in Duncan, Cowichan Bay, Maple Bay, Cobble Hill, Mill Bay, Shawnigan Lake, Chemainus, Crofton, Ladysmith, or Lake Cowichan. But a little prep on your end goes a long way toward making the appointment faster and the results better. Here's what actually helps.

Every extra step we take moving car seats, digging out loose change from cupholders, or waiting for someone to move a second vehicle out of the driveway is time we could be spending on the actual detail. For a Full Detail (from $219 sedan / $249 SUV / $279 truck), we're often on site for two to four hours, so keeping the setup simple means more of that time goes into paint correction, steam cleaning, and interior extraction instead of logistics.
Before We Arrive: A Quick Checklist

items: Remove personal items, especially anything valuable, from the seats, glovebox, and trunk
Take out loose garbage, fast food containers, and recycling
Clear the trunk or truck bed of tools, sports gear, or moving boxes if you've booked an interior or full detail
Make sure there's a parking spot with reasonable access to a driveway or curb (we bring our own water and power on most jobs, but flat, clear pavement makes for the best result)
Let us know about pet hair, spills, or odours in advance so we can bring the right products
If you have a car seat you'd like left in place, tell us ahead of time so we can detail around it

content.text: What You Don't Need to Do

You don't need to vacuum, wipe down surfaces, or wash the exterior before we show up. That's our job, and pre-cleaning can sometimes hide problem areas like stains or trouble spots on the paint that we'd otherwise catch and treat properly. You also don't need to be home the entire time. Plenty of Cowichan Valley customers hand off keys, head into work in Duncan, and come back to a finished vehicle. Mobile detailing works year-round on Vancouver Island, but a covered carport or garage helps on rainy days and keeps freshly cleaned interiors from picking up moisture. If you're out toward Lake Cowichan or Youbou and don't have covered parking, just mention it when you book and we'll plan the appointment around the forecast.
What to Expect Once We're On Site

When we arrive, we'll do a quick walk-around with you to note any problem areas, like tree sap on the hood, pet hair ground into the carpet, or a stain on the driver's seat, so we can target them specifically. Exterior work typically starts with a foam pre-wash and two-bucket hand wash, followed by drying and any add-ons like clay bar treatment or wax. Interior work moves from top to bottom: dusting and wiping surfaces, vacuuming and steam cleaning upholstery or carpets, then a final wipe-down of glass and trim. If you're not home, just leave the keys somewhere accessible and we'll text you photos when the job's done.

Ready to book? Call or text 250-709-1371 for a free quote on an Exterior Detail (from $89), Interior Detail (from $139), or Full Detail (from $219), and we'll walk you through exactly what to expect before we pull into your driveway.
